title: Vassiliev Separation by Abelian-Valued Finite-Type Invariants
exact_target: Can any two distinct oriented knot types be distinguished by some finite-type invariant, allowing its finite order and abelian coefficient group to depend on the pair?

sources.citation: Bruno Dular, Primitive Feynman Diagrams and the Rational Goussarov–Habiro Lie Algebra of String Links, AGT 26:3 (2026), pp. 1037–1038, definitions and m=1 separation question; Ohtsuki problem list for oriented-knot formulation.
